notes.en: I aimed for a clean glyph first: a solid gold figure with generous limb widths so the dual pose survives at navbar size, with the engraved detail held in three ink tiers that fade out as the mark shrinks. The anatomy is still schematic - the horizontal arms are flat ribbons, the hands are little more than tapered mitts, and the face is a blank study rather than a portrait - and the hair reads as a single dark lock instead of curls.
